versions.subject: feat: updates and fixes
versions.detection:
selection:
    ImageLoaded|endswith: '\vsstrace.dll'
filter_windows:
    Image|startswith:
        - 'C:\Windows\System32\'
        - 'C:\Windows\SysWOW64\'
        - 'C:\Windows\WinSxS\'
filter_program_files:
    # When using this rule in your environment replace the "Program Files" folder by the exact applications you know use this. Examples would be software such as backup solutions
    Image|startswith:
        - 'C:\Program Files\'
        - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_*
versions.spl: ImageLoaded="*\\vsstrace.dll" NOT (Image IN ("C:\\Windows\\System32\\*", "C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\*", "C:\\Windows\\WinSxS\\*") OR Image IN ("C:\\Program Files\\*", "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\*"))
